findings.evidence: `code/TauCeti/Analysis/CompletelyMonotone/Basic.lean:133-161` and `:285-299` annotate analogous accessors with `@[grind]`, while the new accessors at `:360-365` and `nonneg` at `:416-420` have no annotation.
findings.fix: Add `@[grind →]` to `IsClosedCompletelyMonotone.continuousOn` and suitable `@[grind =>]` annotations to the characteristic consequences such as `isCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi` and `nonneg`.
findings.issue: `IsClosedCompletelyMonotone` exposes characteristic accessors without the `@[grind]` annotations used by the parallel `IsCompletelyMonotone` and `IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi` APIs, so automation will not decompose the new roadmap predicate.

findings.evidence: `code/TauCeti/Analysis/CompletelyMonotone/LaplaceRepresentation.lean:536-556` defines `RepresentsLaplace` and its two accessors without automation annotations.
findings.fix: Annotate `RepresentsLaplace.isFiniteMeasure` with `@[grind →]` and `RepresentsLaplace.eq_laplaceTransform` with an appropriate `@[grind =>]` annotation.
findings.issue: `RepresentsLaplace` has public characteristic accessors, but neither finiteness nor equality with `laplaceTransform` is exposed to `grind`, forcing downstream users of `bernstein` to manually unpack the representation predicate.

summary: The roadmap-facing theorem name is now corrected, but the new public predicates omit the automation annotations used by the existing characteristic API.
